description: This file implements synchronization logic for shared channels in Mattermost, handling incoming remote cluster messages, user, post, reaction, and acknowledgement synchronization, including metadata handling and mention transformation.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Service class handling synchronization of shared channels, including message processing, user, post, reaction, and metadata management.

methods.name: onReceiveSyncMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming sync messages from remote clusters, unmarshals payload, and processes sync message.

methods.name: processGlobalUserSync
methods.description: Processes global user synchronization messages, upserting users accordingly.

methods.name: processSyncMessage
methods.description: Main handler for processing sync messages, including user, post, reaction, acknowledgement, and membership changes.

methods.name: upsertSyncUser
methods.description: Creates or updates a user based on sync data, ensuring remote ID consistency and adding to team/channel.

methods.name: insertSyncUser
methods.description: Inserts a new user with remote sync considerations, handling username collisions.

methods.name: updateSyncUser
methods.description: Updates existing user data, handling conflicts and cache invalidation.

methods.name: upsertSyncPost
methods.description: Creates or updates a post, handling deletion, editing, and metadata synchronization.

methods.name: syncRemotePriorityMetadata
methods.description: Replaces existing post priority metadata with remote data.

methods.name: syncRemoteAcknowledgementsMetadata
methods.description: Replaces existing post acknowledgements with remote acknowledgements.

methods.name: upsertSyncReaction
methods.description: Creates or deletes reactions based on remote data, ensuring ownership and existence.

methods.name: upsertSyncAcknowledgement
methods.description: Creates or deletes post acknowledgements, ensuring ownership and consistency.

methods.name: upsertSyncUserStatus
methods.description: Updates user status, ensuring remote ID match.

methods.name: transformMentionsOnReceive
methods.description: Transforms mentions in received posts using explicit mention mappings, handling local and remote users.
